about_short_description.short_description: We make it simple to buy and sell energy in competitive markets (B2B SaaS + Marketplace)

product.name: Sparkplug
product.description: A retail energy sales platform that manages customer lifecycle, pricing, commissions, and contract processes for brokers and suppliers.

product.name: CRAFT
product.description: A commission management solution for retail energy suppliers that automates commission calculations and payment reconciliation.

product.name: Exchange
product.description: A secure, API-driven data connectivity platform that enables brokers and suppliers to exchange retail energy market information.

product.name: Propeller
product.description: A sales management solution for retail energy suppliers that connects sales channels to back-office operations.

product.name: Generator
product.description: A web-based tool that enables brokers and suppliers to offer residential and small commercial energy pricing directly on their websites without development effort.
